status: exact linear-rank and degree-count classification for minimal copy symmetries

basisFreeConstraint.localSolution: Y_I^A=n_I V^A with n.n=1 and V.V=-ell^2
basisFreeConstraint.warning: det Gram=0 is weaker in indefinite signature and does not by itself force rank(Y)<=1

branches.name: fixed multiplicity spurion
branches.verdict: target spectrum retained but the ray is not derived

branches.name: global SO(2)
branches.ray: spontaneously selected on S1 modulo the discrete stabilizer

branches.name: local SO(2) with auxiliary connection
branches.verdict: passes classically but Z_q=0 is not protected because f_q^2 is gauge invariant

branches.name: local SO(2) with ordinary kinetic connection
branches.extraMode: massive copy vector for positive kinetic sign, ghost for negative sign

branches.name: exchange Z2
branches.ray: even and odd eigenlines are canonical
branches.condition: without a multiplier constraint and before specifying kinetic degeneracies
branches.verdict: makes W=0 a consistent stationary truncation but does not remove W

anomalyAudit.pureCompensatorSector: real bosonic fields have no perturbative chiral SO(2) anomaly
anomalyAudit.matterExtension: chiral copy charges would require vanishing cubic and mixed gauge-gravitational U(1)-type anomaly sums

decision: Only a local SO(2) quotient removes the ray without a fixed projector, but retaining the 2+1 spectrum requires the unprotected auxiliary surface Z_q=0; all other minimal branches leave an extra mode or an imposed constraint.
